jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About Nu Global

Nu Global is a key driver of Nubank's international expansion, announced on September 10. It is building a simple, trusted financial experience for customers across markets. Nu Global offers a multi-currency digital account for people with global lives, that allows fee-free, fast money movement across more than 35 countries. Check the Nu Global experience and announcement.

About the role

We’re looking for a senior Product Manager to own Nu Global’s growth agenda end to end. This is a dedicated Growth role: you will diagnose the funnel, identify the highest-impact constraints, and run a portfolio of growth programs that turns customer and market insight into measurable, sustained growth.

You are a relentless funnel optimizer—equally comfortable getting into the data, shaping the growth thesis, and driving execution with Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Operations, Risk, and Legal. You will build a disciplined, high-velocity experimentation system and scale the interventions that work across markets. The goal is not to maximize sign-ups in isolation, but to acquire the right customers, help them reach value quickly, and grow engagement and advocacy while protecting customer trust.

Key responsibilities

  • Growth strategy and portfolio: Translate Nu Global’s business goals into a clear growth strategy, measurable outcomes, and a prioritized roadmap, making trade-offs explicit.

  • End-to-end funnel performance: Own the product growth funnel from acquisition and channel handoff through onboarding, verification, activation, first value, referral, and retention. Use data and customer insight to find and remove friction.

  • Growth programs: Build and run a portfolio of coordinated growth programs, including coordination with other Nu markets (Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, US), from problem framing to scale.

  • Experimentation at pace: Establish a fast, rigorous test-and-learn cadence: shape hypotheses, align on success and guardrail metrics, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop.

  • Growth loops and journeys: Develop product-led growth mechanisms such as onboarding, referral, lifecycle journeys, and reactivation that can compound across markets.

  • Analytics and measurement: Partner with Business Analytics on funnel instrumentation, cohort analysis, and experiment evaluation, making sound calls when attribution is imperfect.

  • Cross-functional delivery and responsible growth: Lead through influence across functions and country teams, building growth that is scalable, compliant, and worthy of customer trust.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 8–12 years of product management experience (Senior Manager level), ideally mostly in Growth.

  • Global Expansion: Prior experience with Global Growth Brands such as Uber, Airbnb, Revolut, Wise, PayPal, King, ByteDance, Temu, Shein, Lovable, Duolingo, Open AI is a strong plus.

  • Growth outcomes: Strong record of diagnosing funnel performance and delivering material improvements across acquisition, onboarding, activation, conversion, referral, or retention.

  • Growth program execution: Experience leading growth programs end to end, from opportunity sizing and hypothesis through experimentation, launch, and scale.

  • Analytical rigor: Ability to interrogate funnels and cohorts, define success and guardrail metrics, and evaluate experiments, even with imperfect attribution.

  • AI fluency: Practical experience using AI to accelerate growth discovery, experimentation, or operations, with sound judgment on customer value, privacy, and risk.

  • Leadership and execution: Hands-on, high-ownership style, able to move quickly from insight to action and align senior cross-functional partners.

  • Languages: Fluency in English is mandatory. Portuguese and/or Spanish is a strong advantage. Nice to have: French, German, or Italian.

Location for this opportunity

São Paulo

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Official Work Model

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Explore how we build technology at Nubank:

  • building.nubank.com.br

  • YouTube

  • Listen to our stories on Spotify

 
 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, AI Private Banker
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page


About the role

As a team who drives product development from ideation to full rollout, the Design team ensures that our product experiences are valuable to our users. Designers at Nubank must deal with complex problems and transform them into intuitive, accessible and easy-to-use experiences for millions of people.
At each stage, a Designer must anticipate our customers and business needs, advocate for our users and ensure that the final design surprises and delights them. Achieving this goal requires collaboration with teams of Designers, Researchers, Business Analysts, Software Engineers, Product Managers and many other, working in projects that go from user interviews and prototypes to internal tools and brand assets.
Given this, designers must be flexible and eager to learn - it's unlikely that you'll arrive an expert in all tools and project phases, but you should be humble and have a strong desire and capacity to learn. It's critical that you are able to collaborate with people with varying backgrounds, give good feedback and apply critical feedback received. The combination of these skills along with your talent and technical competence as a designer can make you a great fit for the Nubank Design team.

Once here, you will:

  • Be a technical reference for the team, seeking to adapt and replicate the best practices in the market, increasing the team’s bar;

  • Build links with other business areas at all levels of the organization, influencing business decisions advocating for user-centered design;

  • Inspire fellow product designers, by creating a high bar of quality design work;

  • Establish and promote a healthy team culture that works hand in hand with cross-functional partners and design teams in other Nubank offices;

  • Push the boundaries of your team’s UX/UI/visual execution and help Nubank challenge the status quo.

Requirements

  • Solid expertise in Product Design (UI, UX, and Research);

  • Experience in digital products;

  • Ability to work well in a highly collaborative and cross-functional team;

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment;

  • Ability to influence prioritization in an agile environment. Adapt to shifting priorities and evolving stakeholder’s needs with openness and agility.

 

Our benefits

  • Top Tier Medical Insurance

  • Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

  • 20 days time off and 14 company holidays. 

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

Work Model for this Role

  • Hybrid (3 days in-office per week): Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/ 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Blockchain Security)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the role

The Blockchain Security team sits within the Product Security & Assurance BA, part of the Information Technology and Security (ITSec) BU. Our mission is to support the security of Nu's crypto operation. In the context of Nu's global expansion, keeping these products secure, and demonstrably compliant with financial regulators, is a direct condition for our ability to operate and grow.

As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you own the security posture of our crypto operation. You are the person who thinks like an attacker so our products can withstand real ones: finding vulnerabilities before adversaries do, embedding product security into how crypto products are designed and built, and making sure our controls satisfy both internal risk standards and external regulatory requirements. You won't just run security tools. You'll build and operate the ones that protect our crypto products, from hardened ingress and monitoring/alerting systems to secure secret-management and automated security-review tooling. Your work directly protects customer funds and Nu's ability to run crypto products at scale.

 

You'll be responsible for

  • Applying an offensive security mindset to our crypto and blockchain products: simulating attacks, running penetration tests and security assessments, and turning findings into concrete mitigations.

  • Driving product security across the crypto portfolio: threat modeling, security-by-design reviews, and embedding secure practices into the development lifecycle.

  • Building, operating, and improving in-house security services and tooling that integrate directly with our crypto products, for example hardened ingress/edge controls, security monitoring and anomaly alerting, secure secret-management, and automated security-review tooling.

  • Ensuring our crypto operation meets regulatory requirements: mapping controls to applicable regulations, supporting audits, and producing the evidence regulators and internal risk teams expect.

  • Collaborating with product and engineering teams to design secure blockchain architecture and embed security-by-design into new products.

  • Contributing to security policies, standards, and guidelines that govern blockchain security operations.

  • Using AI to raise the leverage and quality of security work: building and running AI-assisted tooling for tasks like threat modeling, code and vulnerability review, and attack simulation, and helping the team push the frontier of what AI-first security engineering looks like.

  • Staying current on emerging attack vectors, exploits, and best practices across product and blockchain security, and sharing that knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a person who has

Must have

  • Strong product security and/or offensive security background (penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, attack simulation, incident response).

  • Experience embedding security into product development: threat modeling, secure SDLC, security-by-design reviews.

  • Hands-on software engineering ability: you can build and operate security services and automation, not just use off-the-shelf tools. Comfortable writing production code (we work heavily in Clojure; strong experience in any modern language plus willingness to learn Clojure is fine).

  • Solid working knowledge of blockchain and cryptocurrency fundamentals, including how blockchains, wallets, keys, and smart contracts work, enough to reason about their security (expert-level depth not required, but real familiarity is).

  • Strong knowledge of recent and past attack vectors and exploits, and how to remediate them.

  • Experience with security frameworks such as OWASP and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).

  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering: using coding agents and LLMs in daily work, with good judgment about where they help, where they don't, and how to review their output critically.

  • Familiarity with AWS, and solid grounding in operating systems, networks, databases, and infrastructure architecture.

  • Ability to work autonomously and proactively, strong analytical/problem-solving skills, and clear written and spoken English for technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have

  • Deeper knowledge of blockchain/crypto internals: consensus algorithms, cryptographic protocols, smart contracts.

  • Experience auditing smart contracts (e.g. Solidity) or working with DeFi protocols.

  • Experience integrating with third-party crypto custody/infrastructure providers (e.g. Fireblocks, Circle, and similar).

  • Exposure to regulatory or compliance requirements in a financial or crypto context.

  • Experience with bug bounties and/or CTFs.

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or Certified Blockchain Security Professional.

Location for this opportunity

  • São Paulo, Brazil 

  • Campinas, Brazil 

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil 

  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil 

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank

  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

  • Life Insurance

  • Medical Plan

  • Dental Plan

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • Extended Parental Leave

  • Daycare Allowance

  • Parental Consultancy

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Gym Partnerships

  • 30 days of paid vacation

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

 

Work Model for this Role

Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here
